opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a pickup location, pickup/drop-off dates and times, then apply filters or sorting on the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Enter the pick-up location and choose the suggestion
Set the drop-off location if it differs from pick-up
Open the date picker, select the pick-up and drop-off dates, click Done
Set the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filters (car type, passengers, rental company) or change sort order

instances.values: JFK to JFK, Apr 3-6, 9:00am-6:00pm, filters Luxury and 2-5 passengers, sort Recommended
San Francisco, Apr 2 to Apr 9 (dates edited), filters Avis and Economy

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights for a trip type, origin, destination, date and passengers, then filter and pick a flight and ticket type.
steps: Open the Flights tab
Select trip type (one way, round trip or multi-city)
Optionally tick Direct flights only
Enter origin and destination airports/cities
Pick the departure date(s)
Set the number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Sort by Fastest and apply filters
Click See flight, then Select
Choose ticket type and click Next

instances.values: one way, Columbus to Bangalore to Goa, Mar 29, 2 adults, direct only, Fastest, Standard ticket
multi-city, New York to Tokyo Jun 1, Tokyo to Delhi Jun 5, direct only, Fastest, Standard ticket

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search with filters
opportunities.description: On Carnival, pick a destination (and optionally departure port and month) and search cruises, then set the number of guests filter.
steps: Open the Sail To dropdown and pick a destination
Open Sail From and pick a departure port
Open Dates and pick a month
Click Search Cruises
Open the Number of Guests filter and set the count

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: Look up MTA planned service changes for a given route and date.
steps: Click Planned Work in the top navigation
Click Planned Service Changes
Type the route in Search Routes and select it
Open the date picker and choose a date
Read the results

instances.values: route 4, date changed from 4/12 to May 3

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero parking by selecting the Airport tab and an airport, then setting start and end dates.
steps: Click the Airport tab on the home page
Click the search field
Pick an airport from the list or type one
Set the parking start date
Set the parking end date
Click Search

instances.values: Dallas Love Field (DAL), no dates set

opportunities.name: Booking.com airport taxi booking
opportunities.description: Book an airport taxi on Booking.com with pickup, destination, date, time and passenger count.
steps: Click Airport taxis
Enter the pick-up location and choose the suggestion
Enter the destination address and choose the suggestion
Pick the date
Set the time and click Confirm
Set the passenger count
Click Search
Choose a taxi type

instances.values: ORD to 123 Main St, Mar 29, 12:00, 2 passengers, Standard taxi

opportunities.name: Sort and select product on listing page
opportunities.description: Navigate a retailer's category menu, apply filters and sort, then open a product.
steps: Open the category menu and pick the category/subcategory
Apply product filters (type, size)
Open the Sort dropdown and choose an order such as Price Low-High
Open the first product or add it to cart or favorites
